01HOW WE WORK

Principles that shape how we hire, build, and ship.

  • 01

    Ship fast, with customers

    Engineers own features end to end. There’s zero insulation between engineers and customers. This makes us move fast and build the right things.

  • 02

    Own it, break it, learn

    Owning things means making mistakes. We can’t move fast if we always aim to make perfect decisions. It’s better to take action and correct later.

  • 03

    AI-pilled, but human

    AI will change data infrastructure and the whole industry. We want to lead that change, which means we use it as aggressively as we can.
